policy: Training-only labels were adjudicated from exact DOM hierarchy, repeated geometry, card-local image/title/price evidence, saved screenshots, and an independent screenshot-only visual review. The visual model had 0.182 exact-root F1 and frequently mapped approximate boxes to nested descendants, so agreement was evidence rather than a voting rule. All fourteen pages are permanently retired from validation. This artifact is not benchmark gold because the second source is a model review rather than an independent human review.
